speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the exact location of your weakness and decreased sensation in the right arm, and tell me when these symptoms started. Are you experiencing any neck pain, numbness in your hand, or any difficulty with coordination?

speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old male bodybuilder. The patient has been experiencing weakness in his right arm for a few weeks, which has progressively worsened to the point of dropping objects. He also reports a recent unexplained weight loss of 17 pounds and has a history of diabetes. The patient admits to chronic alcohol use, heavy smoking, and anabolic steroid use.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Paraneoplastic Neuropathy / Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) / Spinal Cord Metastasis. Given the unexplained weight loss, smoking history, and steroid use, malignancy is a primary concern. I will order a CT Chest and MRI Cervical Spine to investigate further.
